designationHistory.indexText: The Migratory Bird Conservation Commission approved the purchase of Cedar Island National Wildlife Refuge.

authority.citation: Migratory Bird Conservation Act of 1929; Migratory Bird Conservation Commission approval

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Cedar Island National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

USFWS, 508 Cedar Island National Wildlife Refuge Comprehensive Conservation Plan (ServCat 168355): "The Migratory Bird Conservation Commission approved the purchase of Cedar Island National Wildlife Refuge on August 10, 1964"
